project: 49 Balls Head Road, Waverton NSW — Lot 29 Sec 7 DP 6894
note_revision: Rev U is NEWER than the Rev S set the House/ model was built from (Rev S = 27-01-2026). Reconcile deliberately before adopting; shell dims are near-identical, window schedule may differ slightly.
units: millimetres (DXF model space, architect world coordinates)

layer_legend.A-DOOR: door leaf blocks (INSERT; block name carries WxH or code)
layer_legend.A-GLAZ: window blocks (INSERT; block name carries the size code)
layer_legend.A-GLAZ-IDEN: window tags W1..W26 + code text (e.g. AF0615)
layer_legend.A-GLAZ-CURT: curtain-wall / feature glazing (double-height void, system panels)
layer_legend.A-ROOF / A-ROOF-OTLN: roof + roof outline (on first-floor / elevation sheets)

window_size_code: AU convention: leading letters = type (A awning, F fixed, S/X sliding-stacker, combos e.g. AFA = awning-fixed-awning), the 4-digit group = Width then Height in 100mm units. e.g. AF0615 = 600w x 1500h; FCM 2230 = 2200w x 3000h; AFA3040 = 3000w x 4000h (feature/void glazing).
coordinate_hint: DXF is plan-space mm at architect world coords; the House/ Three.js model uses metres, Y-up, X+=East, Z+=North(street/high). To place: take DXF (x,y) mm, /1000 -> metres, map plan-X->model-X(E/W) and plan-Y->model-Z(N/S) per the site-plan north arrow, and set Y from the level table above. Verify orientation against plan_site.dxf (north arrow) + a known feature (garage door).

files.dxf/section_aa.dxf .. section_ee.dxf: Sections A-A .. E-E (level heights, roof pitch)
files.windows_doors.csv / .json: Extracted window+door schedule (exact mm positions, rotation, decoded WxH)
